description: Defines the PlaywrightPipeServer class which manages a server for inter-process communication via named pipes or sockets, handling connections, initialization, and shutdown procedures within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: PlaywrightPipeServer
classes.description: A server class that manages IPC connections for Playwright using named pipes or sockets.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the server with a Browser instance and sets up disconnection handling.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified pipe name, setting up connection handling.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedBrowserMode
methods.description: Configures the server to operate in pre-launched browser mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server and all active connections gracefully.
